title: Check Your Lung Health Risk.
hero.text: Answer a few simple questions to understand your possible lung health risk.

intro.heading: What This Screening Helps Identify
intro.text: This quick screening tool looks at breathing symptoms, smoking history, and age to help identify whether you may be at lower risk or may need further medical evaluation for possible COPD.

q1.label: In the last 4 weeks, how often were you short of breath?

options.2: Most or all of the time

q2.label: Do you ever cough up mucus or phlegm?

q3.label: Do your breathing problems limit your daily activities?

q4.label: Have you smoked at least 100 cigarettes in your life?

notes.lower: If you still have breathing problems, see a doctor.
notes.copd: See a doctor for a breathing test (spirometry).
